patthana23.13:1.1: Nakusalaṃ nahīnaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā akusalo hīno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṃkhittaṃ.) Hetuyā tīṇi…pe… avigate tīṇi.
patthana23.13:2.1: Nakusalaṃ namajjhimaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato majjhimo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṃkhittaṃ.) Hetuyā cha, adhipatiyā cha…pe… vipāke tīṇi…pe… avigate cha.
patthana23.13:3.1: Nakusalaṃ napaṇītaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo paṇīto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṃkhittaṃ.) Hetuyā cha…pe… āsevane tīṇi…pe… vipāke tīṇi…pe… avigate cha.
